title: Alkalimeter
summary: ALKALIM'ETER, noun [Alkali and Gr. measure.] An instrument for ascertaining the strength of alkalies, or the quantity of alkali in potash and soda.

inlines.v: ALKALIM'ETER, noun [Alkali and Gr. measure.] An instrument for ascertaining the strength of alkalies, or the quantity of alkali in potash and soda.
